reason: A cross-platform utility that automatically opens the local DSH Web UI in a browser after the web server is ready.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 服务器成功启动后，自动使用 Chrome、Chromium 或系统默认浏览器打开本地页面。
summaries.en: Automatically opens the local DSH Web UI in Chrome, Chromium, or the system default browser after the web server starts successfully.

capabilities: Reads the local web server port to construct a loopback URL
Launches Chrome, Chromium, or the system default browser through platform-specific commands
Starts the browser process detached from the host application
